lines.text: Jonathan secretly crossed toward the Philistine outpost while Saul stayed under the pomegranate tree in Migron with six hundred men.
Jonathan had to cross a pass with two cliffs, Bozez and Seneh, one toward Michmash and the other toward Geba.
Jonathan said nothing can hinder the LORD from saving, and that an invitation to come up would be their sign.
Jonathan climbed up on his hands and feet, he and his armor-bearer struck down about fifty men, and panic spread.
Saul told Ahijah to bring the ark, and the LORD saved Israel that day as the battle moved beyond Bethel.
